title: MetricObservation
description: One reported value against a Metric, with dimension values, period, and observation-level attributes. The observation / scoring separation extends from per-record scoring (Principle 6) to aggregate metrics: a MetricObservation is to a Metric what a ScoringEvent is to a ScoringRule. Scale is fixed by Metric.unit and Metric.multiplier; when UNIT_MEASURE also appears in attribute_values, it must equal Metric.unit. The observation cannot override scale.

items.description: Identifiers carried by this entity, such as national ID numbers, program IDs, or identifiers asserted by an identity document.

metric.description: The URI of the Metric this observation reports a value against.

period.description: The temporal coverage of this observation.

items.description: The ordered list of {dimension_uri, code} pairs that locate this observation in the metric's DSD. Ordering matches Metric.dimensions; every dimension declared on the Metric must have a value on every observation (W3C Data Cube integrity constraint IC-11).

metric_value.description: The numeric value reported by this observation. Scale is fixed by Metric.unit and Metric.multiplier: for value_type proportion with unit unitless, the value is in 0..1; with unit PT, the value is in 0..100. The observation cannot override scale.

items.description: The list of {attribute_uri, value} pairs that decorate this observation, series, or dataset. When UNIT_MEASURE appears here, it must equal Metric.unit.

calculation_uri.description: The URI of the MetricCalculation definition this observation realises.

execution_uri.description: Optional URI of an execution record (provenance: software agent, run timestamp, parameter set). Light PROV-O alignment recommended; full execution-provenance shape is deferred.
